name: The Hiking Hawk
summary:
In a land where snow never melts and the wind sings through frozen cliffs, a determined young hawk sets his eyes on the peak of the tallest mountain.

But this hawk is different from the rest — instead of soaring through the sky, he chooses to climb, jump, and bounce his way to the top.

Armed only with his spring-loaded boots and pure determination, he begins his journey through slippery slopes, crumbling ledges, and ancient frozen ruins.

Along the way, danger waits behind every rock and cloud:

Ice Bats swoop in to knock him off course.

Giant Yeti stomp the ground and shake the trails.

But with every bounce, every clever jump, he gets closer to the top — where no bird has ever reached by foot (or claw).
